Two of the Saudi Pro League ’s heavyweights met in a high-stakes tactical battle that tested the discipline and resolve of both squads. With the eyes of the footballing world on Riyadh, the encounter promised to be a defining moment in the season's narrative. A Physical Opening Exchange The match, held on April 29, 2026 , began with a palpable intensity that quickly translated into a series of physical challenges. The referee was forced to reach for his pocket early as both sides struggled to find a rhythm amidst a flurry of fouls. Al Nassr defender Abdulelah Al Amri was the first to see yellow in the 12th minute, setting a combative tone for the opening period. Al Ahli Jeddah responded with their own aggressive press, leading to a booking for Valentin Atangana Edoa shortly after. As the first half progressed, the game became a war of attrition in the midfield. Clear-cut chances were a rarity as the defensive units remained compact. Ziyad Aljohani of Al Ahli received a caution in the closing moments of the half, sending the teams into the tunnel with the scoreline still level but the atmosphere reaching a boiling point. Ronaldo Breaks the Deadlock The second half saw an increase in urgency from the home side. Despite Merih Demiral receiving a yellow card for Al Ahli early in the period, the visitors initially managed to frustrate the Al Nassr frontline. Tactical adjustments followed, with Al Ahli introducing Firas Al-Buraikan in place of Wenderson Galeno to spark a counter-attacking threat, but it was the hosts who finally found the breakthrough. In the 76th minute, the stadium erupted as Joao Felix carved open the defense with a precise delivery. Cristiano Ronaldo was perfectly positioned to capitalize, showing his trademark clinical edge to fire Al Nassr into a 1-0 lead. The goal forced Al Ahli to commit more men forward, leaving spaces in behind that the home side were eager to exploit as the clock ticked toward the final whistle. Coman Puts the Game Beyond Reach As the match entered its final stages, Al Nassr manager looked to freshen up the attack, introducing Ayman Yahya for Sadio Mane . The substitution proved to be an inspired move. In the 90th minute, Yahya turned provider, setting up Kingsley Coman for a composed finish that effectively ended the contest. The goal secured a 2-0 cushion, though the drama was far from over as the match descended into a frantic stoppage-time period. A series of bookings followed in the final minutes, with Ivan Toney , Ayman Yahya , and even the goalscorer Kingsley Coman receiving yellow cards as tempers flared. Despite the late tension and a host of substitutions—including the departure of Ronaldo to a standing ovation— Al Nassr held firm. The referee eventually brought an end to the proceedings after thirteen minutes of added time, confirming a hard-fought and significant win for the Riyadh giants.

An Intense Encounter Lights Up the Night The Stadium played host to an epic battle in the Saudi Pro League on May 12, 2026, as Al Nassr and Al Hilal Saudi FC clashed in an electrifying fixture. The match promised high-quality football and did not disappoint, delivering moments of individual brilliance, sustained tension, and a stunning late twist. The Game Takes Shape in the First Half From the opening whistle, the intensity was palpable. Both teams sought to impose their rhythm, trading blows and carving out opportunities. The first significant breakthrough came in the 37th minute when Mohamed Simakan found the net for Al Hilal , with a crucial assist provided by Kingsley Coman . The goal spurred the visiting side, who then grew in confidence and began to dictate play more effectively. However, the first half was characterized by a string of yellow cards for both teams, underscoring the combative nature of the contest, with bookings for Al Nassr's Ali Al-Hassan and Abdulelah Al Amri , and Al Hilal's Hassan Al Tambakti before the break. Second Half Packed with Tension and Twists The second half commenced with Al Nassr determined to find an equalizer. The game remained fiercely contested, with both sides making substitutions in a bid to alter the momentum. At the 64th minute, Al Hilal's Sergej Milinković-Savić was shown a yellow card. Al Nassr pushed for an offensive surge, leading to bookings for Joao Felix and Ayman Yahya in the closing stages. The tension was electric, with every possession fought for at the absolute limit. Dramatic Late Finale Decides the Victor As the match drew to a close, fate intervened with an unexpected turn of events. In the eighth minute of added time, an unfortunate play resulted in a spectacular own goal from Al Hilal's goalkeeper, Bento Krepski , who inadvertently directed the ball into his own net. This own goal sealed the victory for Al Nassr in a dramatic finish. Shortly after, Al Hilal's Theo Hernandez also received a yellow card. The game concluded with emotions running high, following a contest where luck, or the lack thereof, played a decisive role in the final outcome. On May 21, 2026, the Pro League atmosphere reached a fever pitch as Al Nassr hosted Damac in a fixture filled with star power and high expectations. Both sides took to the pitch knowing that every moment would count in a contest that kept fans on the edge of their seats until the very end. Breaking the Deadlock in the First Half The match began with a series of physical challenges as the referee looked to keep control, issuing yellow cards to Damac defenders Dhari Sayyar Al-Anazi and Sanousi Al-Hawsawi early on. However, the technical quality of the home side eventually told. In the 34th minute, Joao Felix turned provider with a clever assist, finding Sadio Mane who made no mistake in clinical fashion to give Al Nassr the lead heading into the break. Second Half Drama and Penalty Pressure The second half saw the intensity ramp up significantly. Kingsley Coman doubled the advantage in the 52nd minute following an assist from Abdullah Alkhaibari , but the celebrations were momentarily halted when Damac fought back. After Cristiano Ronaldo received a yellow card, the visitors were awarded a penalty in the 58th minute, which Morlaye Sylla converted with composure. The game briefly hung in the balance as Sadio Mane and Jamal Harkass also found their names in the referee's book during a fiery spell of play. Ronaldo Takes Center Stage Cometh the hour, cometh the man, as Cristiano Ronaldo reminded everyone of his enduring class. The Portuguese legend found the back of the net in the 63rd minute to restore a two-goal cushion and effectively kill off the Damac momentum. Despite a flurry of tactical substitutions from both managers, Ronaldo wasn't finished, adding his second of the night in the 81st minute. As the clock wound down, Al Nassr managed the final stages professionally, securing a hard-fought victory on a night where their attacking trident proved too hot to handle.

The Pro League stage was set for a massive showdown as Al Shabab and Al Nassr faced off in a fixture filled with star power. Both teams entered the pitch on May 7, 2026 , looking to assert their dominance in one of the season's most anticipated matchups. João Félix Ignites the Match The contest began with an explosive tempo that favored the visitors almost immediately. João Félix showcased his clinical finishing by finding the back of the net in just the 3rd minute of play. Before the home side could catch their breath, the Portuguese star struck again in the 10th minute, expertly converting a chance created by Abdulrahman Ghareeb . This early two-goal cushion put Al Nassr in a commanding position, forcing Al Shabab to rethink their defensive strategy under immense pressure. Al Shabab's Resilient Fightback Despite the early setbacks, Al Shabab refused to go down without a fight and gradually clawed their way back into the game. Their efforts were rewarded in the 30th minute when Yannick Carrasco scored a crucial goal to reduce the deficit. The strike revitalized the home crowd and shifted the momentum, leading to a balanced period of play where both sides traded blows. The first half concluded with a narrow lead for the visitors, but the intensity suggested more drama was to come. Late Drama and a Hattrick Seal The second half remained a tightly contested affair until the final fifteen minutes sparked a flurry of action. In the 75th minute, Cristiano Ronaldo extended the lead after being set up by Sadio Mane . However, the drama was far from over; Ali Al-Bulayhi struck back for Al Shabab in the 80th minute following an assist from Hammam Al-Hammami , making it 2-3 and setting up a grandstand finish. The closing stages were high-tempered, resulting in yellow cards for Saad Balobaid and Salem Al Najdi . Deep into stoppage time, the tension reached its peak when Al Nassr was awarded a penalty. In the 90+8th minute, João Félix stepped up to the spot and calmly converted to complete a magnificent hat-trick. The goal secured a 2-4 victory, and although the match continued until the 90+11th minute, the outcome was no longer in doubt as the referee blew the final whistle on a pulsating footballing spectacle.
